content.description: Illustration showing hands checking bearings by turning them while applying inward force

items:
CHECK BEARINGS
Turn each bearing by hand while applying inward force. If resistance is felt or if the bearing sticks, replace the bearing.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of bearing using SST tool

items: (a) Using SST, remove the bearing from the armature shaft.
(b) Using SST, remove the other bearing from the opposite side.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool and press being used to install bearings onto shaft

items: (c) Using SST and press, tap the front bearing onto the shaft.
(d) Using a press, install the rear bearing onto the shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing ohmmeter testing between Terminal 50 and Terminal C on magnetic switch

items:
PERFORM PULL-IN COIL OPEN CIRCUIT TEST
Using an ohmmeter, check for continuity between terminal 50 and the terminal C.
If there is no continuity, replace the magnetic switch.

content.description: Illustration showing ohmmeter testing between Terminal 50 and Switch Body on magnetic switch

items:
PERFORM HOLD-IN COIL OPEN CIRCUIT TEST
Using an ohmmeter, check for continuity between terminal 50 and switch body.
If there is no continuity, replace the magnetic switch.
